description: GitHub Actions only, pinned to commit SHAs (specs/design.md, the CI gate). Image contents track latest through the lock and m5's watch, not Renovate (specs/gcp.md).

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for minor, patch and digest bumps, merged without review once ci and cloud-build pass.
Majors change inputs, and no PR check runs auth or setup-gcloud, so a broken major would surface first in a production deploy. Held for review.
